Cue card notes for Sang (first pass):
1) Opening (15s): "We help engineering teams run LLM inference reliably and affordably — same API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
2) Demo hook (30s): call out latency and cost improvements with a live cost-per-token peek.
3) Close (20s): customer outcome + CTA: "Try the hosted API with a sandbox or talk to us about Dedicated capacity."

I'll refine language and push a docx by EOD. Marcus — can you confirm video frame aspect and whether you need raw recordings?
